svg.title: Scenario 8: Player Turn — Warrior Basic Attack Eliminates Goblin

g.text: Scenario 8: Player Turn — Warrior Basic Attack Eliminates Goblin
Goblin's StunEffect expired last round (Scenario 7). specialSkillCooldown = 0 again.
Basic attack now uses applyScaledAttack() with a QTE multiplier — NOT PlayerAction.bAttack().
Warrior (SPD=30) acts first. One hit kills Goblin.
User sees Goblin no longer has Stun icon.
Selects Basic Attack to finish it off.
multiplier from QTE is passed through.
Note: basic attack does NOT go through PlayerAction.bAttack().
Damage scaling is applied directly in BattleEngine.
Wave is empty. No further waves remain.
returns false (game over, not a new wave).
enemies list is empty → all waves cleared.
